name: holding_injective_run
lines: hinj : ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), s.holding j1 = some i → s.holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
⊢ ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), (daRun w m fuel s).holding j1 = some i → (daRun w m fuel s).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
⊢ ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), (daRun w m 0 s).holding j1 = some i → (daRun w m 0 s).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
(∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), s.holding j1 = some i → s.holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2) →
∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), (daRun w m k s).holding j1 = some i → (daRun w m k s).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
⊢ ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), (daRun w m (k + 1) s).holding j1 = some i → (daRun w m (k + 1) s).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
(if (freeMenSet s).Nonempty then daRun w m k (daStep w m s) else s).holding j1 = some i →
(if (freeMenSet s).Nonempty then daRun w m k (daStep w m s) else s).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
(daRun w m k (daStep w m s)).holding j1 = some i → (daRun w m k (daStep w m s)).holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2
⊢ ∀ (j1 j2 i : Fin n), s.holding j1 = some i → s.holding j2 = some i → j1 = j2

steps.tactic:
induction fuel generalizing s with
| zero => exact hinj
| succ k ih =>
  simp only [daRun]
  split_ifs with hne
  · exact ih (daStep w m s) (holding_injective_step w m s hinj)
  · exact hinj
exact ih (daStep w m s) (holding_injective_step w m s hinj)
